answer_1.quote: We evaluate NUDGING across three model families—Llama-2, Gemma-2, and OLMo—on a diverse set of 13 datasets covering general knowledge, reasoning, and open-instruction benchmarks.

answer_2.quote: For math reasoning tasks, following Liu et al. (2024); Shen et al. (2024), we extract the last number in the model's response based on rules. For other tasks, we use GPT-4o to compare the generated answers with the gold answers using a predefined template as shown in Figure .
